title: 第1章 温柔乡英雄冢第2章 雷海异象
content_zh:
第1章温柔乡，英雄冢“沉哥哥，我还想要！”
床榻之上，女子脸上的潮红尚未消散，口里便发出无比诱惑的声音。
萧沉望着上方国色天香的周凌雪，心中再次涌现火热之意。
“好！”
然而，当萧沉正打算再度共赴巫山时，一股强烈的疲惫感侵袭而来，让他露出了尴尬的神情。
“要不，今天先到这，反正我们来日方长。”
“沉哥哥这么快就累了吗？一个月后就是我们大婚的日子，以后你可不能偷懒哦？”
周凌雪轻轻地贴在萧沉的胸膛上，那柔软的身躯让萧沉心神荡漾。
谁能想到，远风城闻名的冰霜美人，也会有如此热情疯狂的一面。
“等到过几日我道骨觉醒，必然能名动天下，届时，便可以风风光光迎娶你了。”
萧沉下意识想要将怀里的佳人搂的更紧，不料，那股疲惫感更加强烈，连带着全身绵软无力，甚至连丹田内的真元力量都无法调动。
“不对……”
萧沉神色骤然一变，“我中毒了！”
“你才意识到吗，还真是蠢！”
周凌雪不知何时已经飘然起身，美眸之中充满了蔑视和冷漠，与先前判若两人。
“是你给我下毒？你为什么要这么做！”
萧沉不敢相信，自己青梅竹马、朝夕相处的未婚妻，竟然会下毒害他！
“说你蠢，你还真是蠢得要命！”
周凌雪穿好了衣裳，语气十分不屑，“你没有任何背景和权势，难道真以为我会看上你吗？实话告诉你吧，我爹已经联系上了皇城王家，不日就会前来提亲！”
“你既然攀附上了皇城王家，又为何要主动献身于我？”

萧沉吼道。
“为的，就是这一刻！”
周凌雪手中多出了一柄利刃，透着森寒之光，“你的道骨，将在我体内觉醒，而这，才是我能够嫁入王家的原因所在！”
“你好狠毒！”
萧沉回想起这段时间的温存，只感到恶心。
假意委身，为的是夺他道骨，嫁入皇城世家！
“与其怪他人狠毒，倒不如怪你自己过于愚蠢，和你父亲一样。”
这时，房门被推开，一名带着阴冷笑容的中年踏步而入。
“你还有脸提起我的父亲？”
萧沉怒意更加强烈，眼前的中年，正是他父亲的结拜兄弟，也是周凌雪的爹，周狂昭。
自从萧沉双亲亡故以后，周狂昭便将萧沉收为义子，还许下婚约，让他和周凌雪完婚。
因此，萧沉对他们非常信任。
“当初杀你父母的时候我都不在乎，我还怕提起吗？”
周狂昭冷哂。
“什么？你个畜牲！”
萧沉几乎发狂，这些年，他竟然都在认贼作父！
“我也不想要他们的命，只怪他们生了你，还将你天生藏有道骨的秘密告诉了我，为了将道骨掌控在手里，我别无选择！”
周狂昭放肆大笑，拥有道骨，周凌雪将成为祁国最顶级的天才！
“周狂昭，周凌雪，你们父女二人真是蛇蝎心肠，我有生之年必亲手将你们剜心腕骨！”
萧沉怒喝。

嗤嗤！
利刃划开了萧沉的身体，鲜血疯狂涌出，周凌雪那张绝美的容颜此刻在萧沉看来却无比恶毒。
轰！
content_en:
Chapter 1 Gentle Township, Tomb of Heroes "Brother Shen, I still want it!"
On the bed, the flush on the woman's face had not dissipated, and an extremely seductive voice came out of her mouth.
Xiao Chen looked at the beautiful and fragrant Zhou Lingxue above him, and his heart felt hot again.
"Okay!"
However, when Xiao Chen was planning to go to Wushan together again, a strong sense of exhaustion came over him, making him look embarrassed.
"How about we come here today? We have a long way to go anyway."
"Brother Shen, are you tired so soon? Our wedding day will be in one month, so you can't be lazy from now on?"
Zhou Lingxue gently pressed against Xiao Chen's chest, and that soft body made Xiao Chen's heart flutter.
Who would have thought that the famous Frost Beauty from Far Wind City would also have such a passionate and crazy side.
"When my Dao Bone awakens in a few days, I will definitely become famous all over the world. By then, I can marry you with all my glory."
Xiao Chen subconsciously wanted to hug the beauty in his arms tighter, but unexpectedly, the feeling of exhaustion became stronger, making his whole body weak and weak, and he could not even mobilize the true energy in his Dantian.
"That's not right..."
Xiao Chen's expression suddenly changed, "I'm poisoned!"
"Did you just realize that you are really stupid!"
Zhou Lingxue had already stood up without knowing when, her beautiful eyes were full of contempt and indifference, she was completely different from before.
"Did you poison me? Why did you do this!"
Xiao Chen couldn't believe that his childhood sweetheart and fiancée, whom he had been with day and night, would poison him!
"You are stupid, but you are really stupid!"
Zhou Lingxue put on her clothes and said in a very disdainful tone, "You don't have any background or power. Do you really think that I will fall in love with you? To tell you the truth, my father has contacted the Wang family in the Imperial City and will come to propose marriage soon!"
"Since you have attached yourself to the Wang family in the imperial city, why do you want to devote yourself to me?"
Xiao Chen roared.
"For this moment!"
There was a sharp blade in Zhou Lingxue's hand, with a cold light, "Your Taoist bones will awaken in my body, and this is the reason why I can marry into the Wang family!"
"You are so cruel!"
Xiao Chen felt sick when he recalled the tenderness during this period.
She pretended to commit herself in order to steal his moral integrity and marry into an imperial family!
"Instead of blaming others for being cruel, blame yourself for being stupid, just like your father."
At this time, the door was pushed open, and a middle-aged man with a cold smile stepped in.
"You still have the nerve to mention my father?"
Xiao Chen's anger became even more intense. The middle-aged man in front of him was Zhou Kuangzhao, his father's sworn brother and Zhou Lingxue's father.
Since the death of Xiao Chen's parents, Zhou Kuangzhao adopted Xiao Chen as his adopted son and made a marriage contract for him to marry Zhou Lingxue.
Therefore, Xiao Chen trusted them very much.
"I didn't even care when I killed your parents. Am I still afraid of mentioning it?"
Zhou Kuangzhao was cold.
"What? You beast!"
Xiao Chen almost went crazy. In these years, he actually considered the thief as his father!
"I don't want their lives either. I only blame them for giving birth to you and telling me the secret that you were born with a Dao Bone. In order to control the Dao Bone in my hands, I have no choice!"
Zhou Kuangzhao laughs wildly and possesses the moral integrity. Zhou Lingxue will become the top genius in Qi State!
"Zhou Kuangzhao, Zhou Lingxue, you two, father and daughter, are really cruel. I will cut out your heart and wrist bones with my own hands during my lifetime!"
Xiao Chen shouted angrily.
Tsk!
The sharp blade cut open Xiao Chen's body, and blood gushed out crazily. Zhou Lingxue's beautiful face seemed extremely vicious to Xiao Chen at this moment.
boom!
